bbcc596ff Bugfix: Correctly respects configuration switch `application.filesystem.unique.paths` when renaming files/folders
5c4ca95e6 Updates copyright message to 2017
1e8d8cde5 Improvement: The auto-renaming of newly created files/folders now happens onCreation instead of in multiple places. This solves multiple cases where creating files caused problems.
cf639bc72 Improves deployment export of files and folders, now only folders and toplevel files are included that either have "includeInFrontendExport" or "useAsJavascriptLibrary" set. Adds some more tests.
19e8ada51 Fixes uniqueness validation, adds tests for dynamic property validation, fixes recurring index rebuild in remote database mode, removes old validator code.
08f70aeab moved validation from Folder to AbstractFile as they also should not contain slashes or zero characters
52fa03f09 changed signature for onModification so that we get information about the modifications. this is used to determine if minification is triggered by a modification
c0f5be7d7 Modified path uniqueness contraint for AbstractFiles to be configurable via structr.conf using application.filesystem.unique.paths.
fad2b335e Updated license headers to 2016 and added where missing.
345f689a5 auto-append the current date/time to uploads if the filename would clash otherwise
14cfea383 created a uniqueness constraint on AbstractFile (see https://github.com/structr/structr/issues/158)
c335e5a3f - removed duplicate test for nonempty name in Folder.java - changed the validation of the nonEmpty name to the ValidateNode method instead of ValidationHelpers method - removed (now) unused imports
f3c33a13d Removed @autor line from JavaDoc in all Java classes.
bf0a1c068 Updated license headers to 2015 and Structr GmbH
ae69f13d3 Many changes in the filesystem area: added navigable folders, modified fulltext indexing to support large files, added deferred indexing, added word limit (default 50k).
51d704b37 Added SSH scp endpoint to allow easy upload of folders, added language-dependent stopword list for fulltext indexing, added agent implementation for background indexing, still work in progress.
2572fd72d Updated license headers
e25c6b56a First working prototype of overridden builtin classes to support linking with dynamic schema types.
ca39d353d Work in progress on replacing builtin types with dynamic types plus mixins.
ecf49fe7a Added query-based paging to websocket List command instead of late filtering. Added isParent boolean property to AbstractFile in order to identiy root folders etc.
9ebdc7196 Work-in-progress on improvements of backend image gallery
c8c58a353 Cleaned-up pom files. Updated license header.
4edb75bcb Updated license header
4bda56be7 Work in progress.
bb62361ce Work in progress.
d1e7be0c7 Work in progress on relationship entities.
55d6fe1fc Work in progress on new relationship entity handling etc.
797cb1ea7 Work in progress.
04d4a6e26 Work in progress.
6b0060ff7 Work in progress on relationship entities.
db1138a9f Work in progress on new relationship entity handling etc.
b73c95119 Fixed bugs in FTP service Added FTP upload Added tests for FTP service
7f4da7a8b Initial version of FTP server implementation
5c7c8d610 refactoring for better separation of core and ui code
d38fc3232 improved UI model to fit backend changes
780ffab23 Modified LinkedListNode and LinkedTreeNode again, use RelationshipType now. Added DataNode which extends LinkedTreeNode. Move typeDefinition from Content to DataNode.
b8c57dc0f Modified internal tree and list node management methods to use dynamic CollectionProperty, made the methods protected for better encapsulation, added AbstractFile as a common base class for File and Folder.
341cdecd3 Added automatic license header management using maven-license-plugin, updated all licenses.
bd4f6ce55 updated license headers to 2013
4aefa2bab re-added missing dirs

content.text:
This confirms it exactly. Commit `1e8d8cde5` removed the `if (validatePathUniqueness)` guard from inside `validatePath()` (moving that gating logic only into the new `validateAndRenameFileOnce()` used by `onCreation`), but left `onModification` calling `validatePath()` directly — unconditionally performing the uniqueness check regardless of the `application.filesystem.unique.paths` setting. The bug-fix commit `bbcc596ff` re-adds the guard, but this time directly in `onModification` rather than inside `validatePath`.

## Bug-Introducing Commits
BIC: 1e8d8cde5bfab25b1d6e5ff39221c237374957f7

## Reasoning

**(1) Investigation:** I traced the history of `AbstractFile.java` with `git log --follow`, looking for prior changes to `validatePath`/`onModification`/`validatePathUniqueness`, since the fix touches exactly that logic. I found the flag `validatePathUniqueness` was originally introduced in `c0f5be7d7` (Jan 2016), where it correctly gated the uniqueness check *inside* `validatePath()` itself — meaning both `onCreation` and `onModification`, which both called `validatePath()`, correctly respected the flag.

**(2) The introducing change:** In `1e8d8cde5` ("The auto-renaming of newly created files/folders now happens onCreation..."), the flag check was moved out of `validatePath()` and relocated only into the new `onCreation`/`validateAndRenameFileOnce()` path (`if (validatePathUniqueness) { valid = validateAndRenameFileOnce(...); }`). This left `validatePath()` performing the uniqueness query unconditionally, and `onModification()` still called `validatePath()` directly with no flag check at all — so renaming a file/folder always enforced path uniqueness, even when `application.filesystem.unique.paths` was set to `false`.

**(3) Evidence:** The bug-fix diff in `bbcc596ff` adds back precisely this guard, but now directly around the `onModification` call site (`if (validatePathUniqueness) { valid = validatePath(...); }`), which is the mirror image of what was removed from `validatePath()` in `1e8d8cde5`. Comparing the file at `HEAD~1` (before the fix) confirms `onModification` called `validatePath()` unconditionally while `onCreation` correctly checked the flag — an asymmetry that only exists after `1e8d8cde5` and is exactly what the fix commit resolves.

I'm fairly confident in this identification given the clear before/after symmetry in the code, though it's possible a later commit also touched `onModification` without reintroducing the guard — I did not find any such intervening commit in the `AbstractFile.java` history between `1e8d8cde5` and the fix (only a license-header-only commit `5c4ca95e6` in between).
